Short update on the Dobropillia/Ocheretyne direction. The situation has become more difficult, and open source maps are behind on the extent of Russian advances and infiltration. This is true both to the east and south of the city as part of the Center Group of Forces' plan to encircle the city from both directions. Russia's rate of advance towards Dobropillia and Druzhkivka has increased in recent weeks. Small Russian infiltration groups from the 177th Naval Infantry Regiment have reached the southeastern part of Dobropillia, and other groups have made it north and northeast of Hannivka on the T0514 road moving from Novyi Donbas. Russia's 9th Motorized Rifle Brigade and 61st Naval Infantry Brigade are attempting to encircle Dobropillia from from the east/northeast using the high ground (including a height south of Stepy), while the 177th is approaching Dobropillia from the east along the T0515 road. Russian forces have reached the mine east of Chernihivka, which will serve as a hub for UAV crews (terricons provide valuable high ground for antenna) and infiltration groups. Russian presence in Bilytske (from the 5th Motorized Rifle Brigade), Chernihivka, and Matyasheve is increasing. To the east, Russia has advanced in Kucheriv Yar and Torske, placing its forces less than 9km from Druzhkivka. This is in part due to the reinforcement of this direction with the 90th Tank Division's 228th and 239th regiments (they took part in the July 22nd mechanized assault), which indicates it is a priority. Further Russian advances in this direction will pose a greater threat to Druzhkiva from the south/southwest, and Dobropillia from the east/northeast. Taking more high ground will also enable Russia to threaten Ukrainian logistics in both directions. In particular, Russian forces could put the Oleksandrivka-Kramatorsk portion of the T0510 road under fire control, which would complicate Ukrainian logistics. Russian forces are employing 15 inch fiber optic cable FPVs in this direction with a range of 50km with strikes in Novodonetske. Novodonetske and Oleksandrivka are being regularly targeted by 1-2 Geran drones per day (5-10 on Dobropillia) and both are also targeted by glide bombs. Although Ukraine's middle strike campaign has raised the costs for Russia and complicated their logistics, Russia still has rough parity in FPVs in this direction and continues to receive sufficient artillery ammunition (the greater problem is the diversity of ammunition sources). The situation east of Kramatorsk and Slovyansk is also becoming more difficult (Russia's Southern Group of Forces was responsible for approximately half of Russia's gains in July), which will force Ukraine into a difficult choice where to commit reinforcements. At this rate, the battle for Dobropillia could begin in the coming weeks or months.

🇷🇺🇺🇦 Prof. John Mearsheimer: ‘Ukraine’s long-range drone attacks into Russia have BACKFIRED, Russia retaliated by closing the Odessa Port and turned Ukraine into a land-locked country.’ ‘The Ukrainian drones have been Ukraine’s great saviour on the battlefield. I believe that this war would have ended a year or two if the Ukrainians didn’t have drones because the Ukrainians have a significant shortage of manpower, a significant shortage of artillery. And in a war that was heavily dependent on just manpower and artillery, I think the Ukrainians would have collapsed a while ago. But the drones have really helped keep them in the fight in an important way. So that’s one dimension to the drone issue. Then there’s the whole question of using drones in long-range attacks into Mother Russia. And this of course is what the Ukrainians have been doing big time in recent months. And I don’t think that those attacks have had any meaningful impact on the course of the war. And of course as you were alluding to, if anything it speeded up the end of the war because there is good reason to think that the Russian response to these long-range drone attacks by the Ukrainians is that the Russians have decided to retaliate by attacking Odessa and other Ukrainian sites on the Black Sea. And this has had a devastating effect on Ukraine because so much of Ukraine’s agricultural product as well as its industrial product moves out of Ukraine via the Black Sea ports. And of course the most prominent one is Odessa. But what’s happened here, and it’s very important to emphasise this, is that the Russians have basically closed the Odessa ports. And the end result is that today Ukraine is effectively a landlocked country. And given the percentage of exports, Ukrainian exports that go out of those ports through the Black Sea, this is going to have devastating effects on the Ukrainian economy. In this segment of Nothing But The Truth, @rajchengappa examines the uneven geography of nutrition under India’s PM POSHAN scheme. The programme aims to bring children to school while providing them with a basic nutritional foundation. But while the Centre sets calorie and protein norms, states decide what goes on the plate. As a result, children in some states receive eggs regularly, while others are served only vegetarian meals. With only 16 of India’s 28 states and four of the eight Union Territories including eggs in regular school meal programmes, the debate raises a larger question about nutrition, food choices and policy. Why does a child’s school meal depend on where they live? Listen to the full podcast. Another useful interview with Deputy Chief of Ukraine’s Defense Intelligence Major General Vadym Skibitskyi. Some highlights: -Russia increased ballistic missile production by suspending production of Kinzhal and Kh-32, both of which have accuracy problems (greater than 30 meter deviation). -"Another example is Russia’s planned production of strike drones for August this year – Geran-1, Geran-2, Geran-3, Geran-4, Geran-5, Garpiya, Gerbera, Gerbera kamikaze and Gerbera seeker drones – 11,000 units in total." -"In July, they slightly reduced the intensity of their drone strikes and cut production as they reconfigure their manufacturing capacity, with a focus on turbojet-powered Geran-4 and Geran-5 drones. In one of their recent attacks, turbojet-powered drones already accounted for 50% of the total. We now need different interceptors capable of matching their speed, or short-range air defense systems." -"According to estimates by Ukraine's Defense Intelligence, July ranked second after February in the number of Kh-101, Kalibr and Kh-32 cruise missiles launched. In February, the Russians launched 157 such missiles at us, while in July they launched 153." -"As for ballistic and hypersonic missiles – the 9M723 missiles used by the Iskander-M system, the RM-48U missiles launched from S-400 systems, and Zircon missiles – the enemy launched 198 of them in July. That is the highest figure this year." -"In the first seven months of this year, they had already produced 33 Zircon missiles, according to data as of August 3. The same applies to Onyx missiles: as of August 3, they had produced 60 units." -"Overall, across the main types of missile weapons, Russia is currently exceeding its monthly production targets by 110-120%. According to intelligence, Russia’s July production target for Kh-101 missiles was met at 140%, for Kalibr missiles at 111%, and for Kh-35 cruise missiles at 200%. -"Russia’s August production target for Kh-101 missiles is 72 units. The target was the same in July, but they produced more – 87 missiles. For the 3M14 Kalibr, the August target is 26 units. The July target was also 26, but they produced 29." -"According to military intelligence, as of August 5, the stockpile allocated to the Russian military grouping stood at around 130 9M723 missiles. The planned monthly production rate is 60 units. However, in July, they produced 65 instead of the planned 60." -"They are not really drawing down their stockpiles. Almost everything being used now is coming straight off the production line. The only exception is the Kalibr missiles - most of them are currently being allocated to other Russian fleets, since all new Russian warships and submarines are equipped with these systems. In effect, those missiles are going into reserve stockpiles. In addition, our interception rate for Kalibr missiles is nearly 100% when air-defense missiles are available." -The recent Kn-23 missile launch missed its target by 15km. -Regarding the S-400's RM-48U missile, "the enemy has established production of this missile: the August target is about 40 units, while its estimated stockpile is 400 units." -Regarding the Rassvet system, "In March 2026, Russia had already placed 16 satellites into low Earth orbit. More launches will follow to create a constellation of 292 satellites by 2027 and expand it to 924 satellites by 2035." newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/taro…

A newly-appointed Ambassador of the Kingdom of Morocco to ASEAN, H.E. Redouane Houssaini, presented his Letter of Credence to the Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat today. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Houssaini on his assumption of office and reaffirmed the ASEAN Secretariat’s commitment to further strengthening the ASEAN-Morocco Sectoral Dialogue Partnership established in 2023. The Secretary-General also expressed appreciation for Morocco’s support for ASEAN Community-building efforts. Ambassador Houssaini thanked Secretary-General Dr. Kao for the warm welcome. He looked forward to working closely with ASEAN Member States and the ASEAN Secretariat in further strengthening Morocco’s ties and cooperation with ASEAN during his term of office. Morocco has accredited its first Ambassador to ASEAN since 2010. Ambassador Houssaini succeeds Ambassador Ouadia Benabdellah, who completed his tenure in April 2025.

With 1.2 billion young people worldwide, nearly 89% of them in developing countries, rural youth represent a major opportunity for economic growth. Investments that connect young people to decent jobs, support youth-led enterprises and strengthen participation in decision-making can turn that potential into income, resilience and broader stability. Through its Agribusiness Hubs Programme, IFAD is helping young people build businesses and create jobs. Across nine African countries, the programme has supported more than 8,000 youth-led agribusinesses and helped create over 59,000 jobs. In #Cameroon, the Youth Agropastoral Entrepreneurship Promotion Programme combined fully subsidized education, blended finance and start-up coaching for young entrepreneurs, along with zero-interest start-up loans and productive credit. The programme delivered a 20% increase in food security, a 48% rise in annual income and average annual profits of US$3,000, with 38% annual growth. Ahead of International #YouthDay, the focus is on the opportunities that open up when young people have access to jobs, support to build businesses and a real say in the decisions that shape their futures. اصلاحات کا اہم حصہ ہے.اس نظام میں ٹیکس گوشواروں کے آڈٹ کے لیے نیشنل فیس لیس آڈٹ ونگ اور اسیسمینٹ کے لیے فیس لیس اسیسمینٹ یونٹ شامل ہیں. فیس لیس نظام میں ٹیکس کیسز کا دائرہ اختیار جغرافیائی حدود سے قطع نظر رینڈم بنیادوں پر مختص کیا جائے گا. چیئرمین ایف بی آر نے وزیراعظم کی ہدایت پر ہر ماہ کے پہلے ہفتے کراچی میں قیام اور کاروباری برادری سے ملاقاتوں پر بریفنگ دی. انہوں نے بتایا کہ کراچی میں سات بڑے تجارتی اداروں کے نمائندوں سے ملاقاتیں کیں اور انکے مسائل سنے. کراچی میں قیام کے دوران کاروباری برادری کو درپیش مسائل فوری حل کئے گئے. برآمد کنندگان کے ٹیکس ریفنڈز کے لیے ٹائم باؤنڈ ایس او پیز جاری کیے جا رہے ہیں. چکوال میں غیر قانونی سگریٹ فیکٹری کے خلاف انٹیلی جنس بیسڈ کارروائی، فیکٹری سیل، غیر قانونی سگریٹ کا ذخیرہ اور مشینری قبضے میں لے لی گئی. صوابی میں بھی غیر قانونی سگریٹ فیکٹری کے خلاف انٹیلی جنس بیسڈ کارروائی کی گئی. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزراء اعظم نذیر تارڑ، ڈاکٹر مصدق مسعود ملک، احد خان چیمہ، محمد اورنگزیب، عطا اللہ تارڑ، شزا فاطمہ خواجہ، معاون خصوصی ہارون اختر، گورنر اسٹیٹ بینک جمیل Today is the birthday of Wolfgang Paul! This physicist was most famous for developing an electromagnetic device known as the Paul trap. Born on this day in 1913, Paul created traps, which are also known as quadrupole ion traps and radiofrequency traps, that use electromagnetic fields to ‘catch’ charged particles so that they may be analysed. These traps, which earned Paul & his colleague Hans Georg Dehmelt the 1989 @NobelPrize in Physics, are an integral part of mass spectrometers, which are large machines used for analysing characteristics of certain atoms, particles and molecules, and chemical structures. These machines are used in our safeguards activities to analyze samples for chemical elements like uranium and plutonium.

Balasubramaniam, Member, NITI Aayog, has authored an opinion piece titled "When a Nation Learns to Care", published in The Statesman, reflecting on the recently released NITI Aayog report "Reimagining Care: Strategies for Empowering Caregivers in Viksit Bharat@2047". The piece emphasises India's changing demographic realities and the importance of building a future-ready caregiving ecosystem through stronger institutions, skilled caregivers, technology-enabled systems, and support for family caregivers. It also underlines the economic potential of the care sector and the opportunity to create dignified livelihoods while strengthening families and communities. दिव्यांग व्यक्तींच्या सक्षमीकरणाला सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते आज नागपूर जिल्ह्यातील अस्थिव्यंग व कर्णबधिर दिव्यांग व्यक्तींना निःशुल्क जयपूर फूट साहित्य व सहाय्यक साधनांचे वाटप करण्यात आले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, देशभरात प्रसिद्ध झालेल्या जयपूर फूट आणि इतर दिव्यांग सहाय्यता साहित्यामुळे अनेक दिव्यांगांच्या जीवनात परिवर्तन घडवणे शक्य झाले आहे. कृत्रिम पाय, हात तसेच अन्य कृत्रिम अवयव बसविल्यानंतर दिव्यांग व्यक्तींना दैनंदिन जीवनातील विविध कामे अधिक सुलभपणे करता येतात. या माध्यमातून त्यांच्या जीवनात सकारात्मक परिवर्तन घडवून आणण्यास मदत होते. भगवान महावीर विकलांग सहाय्यता समिती ही 1975 पासून देशात आणि देशाबाहेर दिव्यांग व्यक्तींना सहाय्य करण्याचे उल्लेखनीय कार्य करीत आहे. पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांनी अंध व शारीरिकदृष्ट्या अपंग व्यक्तींना विकलांग न संबोधता दिव्यांग अशी सन्मानजनक ओळख दिली. दिव्यांगांच्या अडचणी शक्य तितक्या कमी करण्यासाठी सरकार प्रयत्नशील आहे. केंद्र व राज्य सरकारच्या विविध योजनांच्या माध्यमातून सातत्याने शिबिरे आयोजित करून दिव्यांग व्यक्तींना आवश्यकतेनुसार श्रवणयंत्र, व्हीलचेअर, अंधांसाठी काठी तसेच इतर साहित्य व उपकरणे उपलब्ध करून देण्यात येत आहेत. राज्य सरकारने दिव्यांग व्यक्तींचे मानधन वाढवून ₹2500 करण्याचा निर्णय घेतला. त्यांना शिक्षण, रोजगार आणि आरोग्याच्या क्षेत्रात सन्मानाची संधी मिळावी यासाठी सरकार काम करत असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी नमूद केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, कर्णबधीर मुलांमध्ये लहान वयातच आवश्यक वैद्यकीय उपचार करण्यात आल्यास त्यांची ऐकण्याची व बोलण्याची क्षमता विकसित होण्यास मदत होऊ शकते. यासाठी 'कॉक्लिअर इम्प्लांट'सारख्या शस्त्रक्रिया महत्त्वाच्या असून, या उपचारासाठी सुमारे ₹6 ते ₹8 लाख खर्च येतो. हा खर्च महाराष्ट्र शासनाच्या माध्यमातून करण्यात येत आहे. भविष्यात राज्यभरात सर्वेक्षण करून विशेषतः 10 वर्षांखालील कर्णबधिर मुले आढळल्यास त्यांच्यावर योग्य वेळी आवश्यक शस्त्रक्रिया केल्या जातील. दिव्यांग व्यक्तींना दरमहा सुमारे ₹20,000 पर्यंत रोजगाराचे साधन उपलब्ध करून देणे, तसेच गृहनिर्माणासह विविध योजनांमध्ये दिव्यांग व्यक्तींना प्राधान्य मिळावे, यासाठीही शासन प्रयत्नशील असल्याचे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी केले. यावेळी मंत्री चंद्रशेखर बावनकुळे, राज्यमंत्री ॲड. आशिष जयस्वाल, आमदार संजय भेंडे, आमदार डॉ. राजीव पोतदार, आमदार कृपाल तुमाने, आमदार मोहन मते, आमदार चरणसिंग ठाकूर, नागपूरच्या महापौर निता ठाकरे, उपमहापौर लीला हाथीबेड, गटनेते नरेंद्र (बाल्या) बोरकर व इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @narendramodi @Dev_Fadnavis @cbawankule @Ashishjaisw3Adv 1. RSS Chief Mohan Bhagwat has seen a dramatic transformation in his image. It’s evident he was worried about youth anger towards Modi govt. Sort of like the MAGA to the right of the classical Republicans in the US, although we can’t stretch that comparison too far. 3. Equally, Bhagwat has confused the hard liberal community for whom the BJP, Modi & RSS are a three-in-one entity. For some of them Bhagwat now brings relief. Are these winds of change? Is he cautioning Modi govt? Let me underline first of all, the fundamental ideology & philosophy of the RSS isn’t about to change. What’s on display is political pragmatism in the 13th year of power. 4. Modi govt’s capitulation to Jantar Mantar was rather dramatic & total. And just after senior ministers had said they weren’t like the UPA & their ministers won’t resign under pressure. Kiren Rijiju shared an old clipping of an Indira Gandhi interview to a foreign network justifying the Emergency, hinting at “foreign interference”. The threat to India, she said, was internal & external. 5. She talked about conspiracies, the plans to unleash anarchy, that Morarji Desai had threatened to surround the PM’s house & Parliament. Whether she actually felt so besieged she made the biggest blunder of her public life shall remain a matter of debate. What we do know, though, is there was no other power, a mentor, or a guru to caution her against such misadventure. Among the most intriguing artefacts unearthed from the Sindhu-Saraswati Civilization are carefully carved stone boards from 3rd Millennium BCE. These stone boards are marked with geometric grids, often found alongside cubical and elongated dice. Archaeologists have long suggested that these may have served as gaming boards, offering a glimpse into organised leisure and strategic play over 4,500 years ago. While their exact rules remain unknown, some scholars regard them as possible precursors to later Indian board games. The Rig Veda also reflects the enduring place of play in the Indian tradition through its references to dice (akṣa) and games of chance. Whether used for games, counting, or other purposes, these artefacts add another layer to our understanding of the sophisticated social life of the Sindhu-Saraswati Civilization, a legacy whose echoes continue to thrive in Bharat’s living cultural traditions. #SindhuSaraswatiCivilization #AncientPlay #RigVeda #CivilizationalContinuity

//Some conflicts cannot be avoided// Here is a problem no country has solved. 👇 When a government funds frontier technology, the only people who can judge the proposals are usually people already invested in that field. - Take them off the committee and nobody in the room can quite understand the applications. - Keep them on and you get a scandal, a headline. India got that headline last week. - Of the ₹2,192 crore given out in the first round of the new deep-tech fund, 62 per cent went to companies linked to the people who chose them. - Fifteen of the twenty-two firms had ties to seven of the twelve-member committee. Now, nobody argued the companies were bad picks. Agnikul, Ather, Astrome and Manastu Space are firms doing serious work in exactly the areas the fund exists for. The objection was to how they were chosen, not to who was chosen. First the government answered on the expected lines: - Rules written before the first meeting, not after - Any member linked to an applicant must declare it and step out - Two-thirds of the committee needed just to recommend a proposal - The final call rests with a board of secretaries Then, the official in charge said something officials rarely say out loud — Some conflicts cannot be avoided, so you write the rules to keep them from deciding the result. He is right. America has been arguing about this since 1945. Consider the research programme that gave the world radar, penicillin at scale and the atom bomb. - Nearly half its budget went to MIT, Harvard and Caltech. - The presidents of all three sat on the committee handing out the money. The man in charge was Vannevar Bush. - He had been dean of engineering at MIT, - Ran one of America's largest private research funders, - And had co-founded the firm that became Raytheon. Senator Harley Kilgore spent the war saying this was a racket. While he lost the fight over what the postwar agency should look. But his ideas came back anyway, as rules, and those rules are why anyone can check where American research money goes today. Here are the rules America made: - Acting on a decision you have money in became a criminal offence - Exceptions for the expert an agency genuinely cannot replace - A public note naming the person, published before the meeting - Number of such exceptions capped each year and reported to Congress The CIA went further. It built a venture fund and staffed it with working venture capitalists, because nobody else could win good deals in Silicon Valley. A newspaper later found that nearly half its trustees had a financial link to a company the fund had backed. Its portfolio includes Palantir and Anduril. How many would now call seeding those two a mistake? Another agency tried the opposite. After a genuine scandal it banned its scientists from taking drug company money, and five thousand of them had to sell shares. Later, it could not fill its senior posts. The people it needed were the ones it had just shut out. America's Covid vaccine programme, for what it is worth, ran on looser rules than India's. It still worked. Then there is the case that should give both sides pause. Three companies borrowed from the same American programme in the same two years. All three were called politically connected. - Two went bankrupt - One repaid nine years early - One was Tesla None of this makes the worry fake. Recusal mechanism does have a hole too. The circle is small, so when a member steps out of the room, everyone left can work out whose application is on the table. This piece in @SwarajyaMag goes through eighty years of this argument. India has given out just about a fiftieth of this fund. The ₹1 lakh crore behind it is meant to lift an R&D effort still stuck at 0.84 per cent of GDP, against 3.4 per cent in America and 2.6 per cent in China. So the actual questions aren't about the money already spent, but about who sits in the room for the other 98 per cent, and what they disclose on record before they do. महाराष्ट्र की सियासत में पिछले कई दिनों से हलचल है. पीएम मोदी सोमवार को शरद पवार गुट के सांसदों से मुलाकात करेंगे.हालांकि, एनसीपी (एसपी) की कार्यकारी अध्यक्ष सुप्रिया सुले पहले ही यह साफ कर चुकी हैं कि इस बैठक में महाराष्ट्र के मुद्दों पर चर्चा होगी. सुले ने अपने बयान में कहा, 'पीएम मोदी ने सोमवार को एनसीपी सांसदों से मिलने पर सहमति जताई है ताकि सांसद अपने क्षेत्र से जुड़े मुद्दे उनके साथ डिस्कस कर पाएं. चूंकि संसद नहीं चल रही है इसलिए हमने एक मीटिंग की मांग उठाई थी.' लेकिन संभावना जताई जा रही है कि इस बैठक में परिसीमन बिल पर दोनों पार्टियों के बीच चर्चा हो सकती है. विपक्ष ने महिलाओं के आरक्षण को लागू करने से जुड़ी सरकार की प्रस्तावित परिसीमन प्रक्रिया पर चिंता जताई है. इस बैठक से पहले महाविकास अघाड़ी की पार्टियों में एक अजीब से बेचैनी पसरी हुई है. इसमें कांग्रेस और उद्धव ठाकरे की शिवसेना (यूबीटी) शामिल है. ये दोनों ही पार्टियां इंडिया गठबंधन का भी हिस्सा हैं. इस मामले पर शिवसेना (यूबीटी) के राज्यसभा सांसद संजय राउत ने कहा कि उन्होंने सुले से बात की है. उन्होंने कहा,'हम सब एमवीए का हिस्सा हैं. पवार साहब हमारे गाइडिंग फोर्स हैं. एमवीए में कोई कन्फ्यूजन नहीं है, कोई भी एनवीए छोड़कर नहीं जा रहा है.' वहीं दूसरी ओर कांग्रेस का कहना है कि अगर यह बैठक महाराष्ट्र के लिए है तो शुभकामनाएं हैं. पार्टी के नेता विजय वडेट्टीवार ने कहा, 'मुझे नहीं पता कि वे बार-बार मोदी-शाह के दरबार में क्यों जा रहे हैं.' उन्होंने कहा, पता नहीं एनसीपी (एसपी) का परिसीमन बिल पर क्या स्टैंड होगा. कांग्रेस ने एनसीपी (एसपी) से कहा है कि वह पीएम मोदी के साथ बैठक के दौरान इंडिया ब्लॉक का स्टैंड साफ कर दे और बता दे कि प्रस्तावित परिसीमन बिल को महिला आरक्षण के मुद्दे से लिंक नहीं किया जाना चाहिए. #PMModi #Maharashtra #NCP #Meeting | #ZeeNews

An Indian Express front page last Friday had one number flashing prominently — That 62 per cent of the ₹2,192 crore given out in the first round of India's new RDI fund, was to companies linked to the people who chose them. Fifteen of the twenty-two companies had ties to seven of the twelve members on the selection committee. At first glance it looks like a scandal. But read further and you notice that the questions were now over if companies were bad picks. Agnikul, Ather, Astrome, Manastu Space are all serious firms working in exactly the areas the fund was set up for. The objection was to how they were chosen, not to who was chosen. The government answered in usual points — - The rules were written before the first meeting, not after - Any member linked to an applicant has to declare it and step out - A proposal needs two-thirds of the committee just to be recommended - The final decision is taken by a board of secretaries, not by the committee And then the official in charge said something officials rarely say out loud — that in some cases you cannot avoid conflict at all, so you write the rules to make sure it does not decide the result. Now that is not an exclusively Indian problem. The same accusation was once made against the men who ran America's wartime research, the effort that produced radar, penicillin at scale and the atom bomb. Nearly half that budget went to three institutions whose presidents were sitting on the committee that handed out the money. The man in charge had come from MIT, ran one of America's biggest private research funders, and had helped start the company that later became Raytheon. One senator spent the war years making the same argument the Indian Express made last week. He lost the fight over what the new agency should look like. But most of his ideas came back later as rules, and those rules are why anyone can check where American research money goes today. Here is what America ended up doing: - Made it a criminal offence for an official to act on a decision he has money in - Then allowed an exception for an expert the agency genuinely cannot replace - And put a price on that exception, a public note naming the person, published before the meeting There is also a warning in this history. One agency tried to get rid of the problem completely and barred its scientists from taking industry money. Result? It could not fill its senior posts, because the people it wanted were the people it had just shut out. There is also one case that should give both sides pause. Three companies borrowed from the same American programme in the same two years. All three were accused of being politically connected. - Two went bankrupt - The third repaid nine years early - The third was Tesla This piece in @SwarajyaMag goes through eighty years of this argument. The law, the exception, the agency that could not hire, and what Washington eventually decided about judging a fund on one loan versus ten years of them. India has given out about a fiftieth of this fund so far. The ₹1 lakh crore behind it is meant to raise an R&D effort that is still only 0.84 per cent of GDP, against 3.4 per cent in America and 2.6 per cent in China. So the real question is not about the money already spent. It is about who sits in the room for the other 98 per cent, and what they have to declare before they do. سواد رسانه‌ای به توانایی و قدرت دسترسی، تحلیل، ارزیابی و انتقال اطلاعات و پیام‌های رسانه‌ای که می‌توان در چارچوب‌های مختلف چاپی و غیرچاپی عرضه نماید گفته می‌شود. سواد رسانه‌ای یکی از سوادهای دوازده‌گانه است که لزوم یادگیری آن توسط یونسکو و سایر نهادهای بین‌المللی و ملی مسئول در زمینه‌ی آموزش توصیه شده است. همچنان در یک تعریف دیگر، سواد رسانه‌ای مجموعه‌ چشم‌اندازهایی است که فرد برای استفاده از محتوا و پیام‌های رسانه‌ای به‌کار می‌گیرد. سواد رسانه‌ای یک نوع درک متکی بر مهارت است که می‌توان براساس آن انواع رسانه‌ها را از یک‌دیگر تمیز داد و تولیدات رسانه‌ای را از یک‌دیگر تفکیک و شناسایی کرد. سواد رسانه‌ای توانایی بررسی، تجزیه و تحلیل پیام‌هایی که اطلاع‌دهنده و سرگرم‌کننده هستند و هر روز به ما عرضه می‌شوند می‌باشد. همچنان سواد رسانه‌ای توانایی استفاده از مهارت‌های تفکر انتقادی و رابطه‌ی آن با تمام رسانه‌ها است؛ از ویدیوکلیپ‌ها و محیط‌های شبکه‌ای گرفته تا مکان‌های تولیدی در فیلم‌ها و نمایش‌های معنوی در تابلوها. سواد رسانه‌ای طرح سؤال‌های مناسب پیرامون آنچه وجود دارد و دیده می‌شود و توجه کردن به آنچه که دیده نمی‌شود، انگیزه‌ها، ارزش‌ها، مالکیت، سرمایه و آگاه‌بودن از آن که چطور این عوامل بر محتوای پیام‌ها تأثیر می‌گذارند می‌باشد. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/258811

‼️ Royal Navy spy drones used by Britain’s elite special forces secretly sent data to China. ‼️ The cameras on the K3 Scout surveillance drones had components made in China which were secretly transmitting information to a device in the country. The Royal Marines have been using the £12M fleet since March and the Ministry of Defence (MoD) was forced to remove all internet connectivity from the cameras after discovering the breach. The drones were supplied by a major British defense contractor, Kraken Technology Group, which sourced the cameras from a third party who had given assurances about their security. An investigation into the drones revealed that the cameras were transmitting “heartbeat communications” — data to confirm they were online and functioning normally — to an IP address in China. The discovery triggered national security fears that security-cleared staff at the Special Boat Service (SBS) headquarters in Poole, Dorset could have been exposed. The K3 drones made up part of a future defense package offered by the UK to secure the freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz. Preparations for Britain’s plans in the Gulf had been conducted on the drones. “This is major failure to check origins of components and we have lost confidence in the platform.” There are also concerns that the surveillance drones have been near highly sensitive meetings between senior special forces staff, and that cameras remained active even when the drones were switched off. The revelation comes amid a growing threat from China, despite efforts by the Labour Government to thaw relations with the ruling Chinese Communist Party. A number of supply-chain vulnerabilities have forced the MoD to remove Chinese hardware and cameras from sensitive spaces. The SBS has banned Chinese-made electric cars from its headquarters over similar espionage concerns. Downing Street has begun a diplomatic reset with Beijing through a series of high-profile visits to the country, with the hope of lucrative trade agreements. Earlier this year, the Government approved plans for a Chinese super-embassy at Royal Mint Court in the heart of London, despite concerns about the site’s proximity to sensitive communication lines. MoD: “A routine cyber vulnerability assessment identified an issue affecting a Kraken Unmanned Surface Vessel sub-system used by the Royal Navy. A thorough investigation found no evidence of MoD data or systems being accessed, compromised or transmitted externally. The breach is a major dent to the Navy’s Project Beehive, a programme to develop a combined fleet of uncrewed vessels and traditional warships. The Navy purchased the K3 Scout drones from Kraken as part of the Royal Navy’s surface flotilla. The vessels, operated by the Coastal Forces Squadron and the 47 Commando unit of the Royal Marines, were intended to modernize British war-fighting capabilities and keep pace with adversaries. The K3 Scout model, designed to carry a 600kg payload and operate continuously for 30 days, has also been purchased by the US Special Operations Command and has participated in NATO trials in the Baltic. The UK Government has pledged to accelerate military innovation and make procurement “unashamedly pro-Britain”. But the findings highlight China’s dominance in the supply chain, even when equipment is marketed as British-made. Kraken Technology Group: “We are aware that some third-party, NDAA-compliant cameras had a small number of components originating from outside the UK. 🦁 On World Lion Day, we celebrate India’s remarkable journey in lion conservation. India’s success in conserving the Asiatic Lion is a proud testament to our unwavering commitment to wildlife and biodiversity. From protecting critical habitats to strengthening conservation efforts, India has demonstrated that development and nature conservation can move forward together. From 523 in 2015 to 891 in 2025, the steady growth of the Asiatic Lion population reflects the dedication of our forest officials, conservationists, local communities and all those working tirelessly to protect this magnificent species. As we mark World Lion Day, let us reaffirm our resolve to safeguard our natural heritage and ensure that the roar of the Asiatic Lion continues to resonate for generations to come. Video

“Rahhhh-ger CLARA Ship…the deck is moving.” Landing Signals Officers, aka “Paddles,” are the heartbeat of a Carrier Air Wing. Sometimes they give you an arguably undeserved bad grade (what do you mean that was a “full high” at the start…I had a rails pass all the way down!). And then they save your life. I met my first squadron off the coast of Japan in Feb 2008. I had a grand total of 22 Super Hornet traps under my belt and was thrust into the big leagues at the tender age of 26. Winter in the Sea of Japan is tough. The cold weather meant we needed to wear impermeable, full-body rubber suits under our flight gear, providing survival time if we had to eject into the frigid water. It also meant the seas were rough and the cloud cover was often low. A perfect mix for a young “nugget” pilot like myself to get himself into trouble when landing. To be blunt, I started as a below average ball flyer. My landing grades were bad. And then I got launched into a marginal weather day in pitching deck conditions. The flight itself was uneventful. But the 75 minutes of flight time was overshadowed by the inevitable need to land back on the ship in what we knew were going to be sporty conditions. The 5 minutes before landing was spent completely in the clouds. We only had one navigation aide available that day due to ships maintenance, so the air traffic controllers talked us down to a point where they handed us off to the LSOs. The controller ended with an abrupt “you’re at three quarters of a mile…on glide slope, on centerline, call the ball.” I couldn’t see the ship. Mustering as much confidence as I could in that terrifying moment, I abruptly pushed over the radio “CLARA ship.” CLARA means you can’t see something. “CLARA ship” means I couldn’t see the ship. And I was 15 seconds to landing, traveling 150 miles per hour, with a 700 foot per minute descent rate. Then the voice of CAG Paddles calmly slid into my ears: “Rahhhh-ger CLARA ship…the deck is moving. You’re a little high, easy with it.” This tested, 32 year old man, standing on the back of the ship, had my landing light in sight, and started smoothly talking me down. He also noted that the carrier deck was pitching up and down…implying he was gonna get me aboard safely. Those surreal moments passed with confident, directive, but calming words pouring into my headset that my hands and eyes instinctively responded to. The hundreds of practice passes learning that guidance made the real thing automatic. Suddenly, the ship appeared and a moment later we jerked to a stop. We had landed. “Nice work 107.” Thanks Paddles. For getting me aboard safely and saving my life. I never disputed a landing grade after that. Fly Navy. Video

Gustavo Bolívar (@GustavoBolivar) El 2 de marzo de 2018, en Cúcuta, estaba haciendo un live para registrar el momento de la llegada de Gustavo Petro al parque general Santander cuando de repente empezaron a sonar disparos, justo en la ventana en la que venía el candidato. Todo quedó registrado en video. Nunca dejé de transmitir. En seguida la Fiscalía de NHM salió a decir que se trataba de piedras. Contraté expertos y me dijeron que una piedra jamás produciría un daño semejante en un blindaje 5. La prensa jamás mostró indignación ni envió periodistas a ver el carro a preguntarles a los peritos si había sido un atentado o no. Una de las balas pegó en el vidrio delantero con el carro en movimiento y a gran velocidad. Sin duda era un francotirador. Ninguna persona se atraviesa a una camioneta escoltada con motos para tirar una piedra, de frente. En fin, solo quería decirles que ese día por poco matan a Gustavo Petro. La camioneta era polarizada y a la ventana por la que yo venía, nunca le dispararon. Sabían de qué lado venía el candidato desde que se subió en el parqueadero del hotel donde nos quedamos y por ese lado dispararon. Para bajar los ánimos, y sin conocer el veredicto de un perito, ese mismo día el candidato dijo que se trataba de piedras pero no fue así. Siempre han querido matar a Petro. Incluso ahora que está en la presidencia. País inviable. Maldita violencia. NEWS: Tesla wants to build solar panels from scratch in Texas and the plans are massive. A new public filing lays out the whole thing. Tesla is calling it Project Crystal Sun and it would rise on about 3,000 acres in Fort Bend County, just outside Houston. What makes it stand out is that Tesla would do everything in one place. It would start with raw silicon and carry it all the way to finished solar panels, instead of relying on parts shipped in from overseas. The size of the bet is about $10.1 billion. Around $1.5 billion goes to land and buildings and $8.6 billion goes to equipment. Tesla wants to break ground this year, finish in 2028 and start making solar cells in early 2029. Once it is fully running, the plant would employ 9,712 people, with the average job paying around $122,000 a year. At the busiest point of construction, another 1,147 workers would be on site. The effect on Texas is where it gets big. The filing estimates the plant would add about $107 billion to the state's economy, lift local earnings by $68 billion, support more than 13,000 jobs in total and bring in around $6.4 billion in state and local taxes over time. And there is a bigger goal behind it. Back in January, at the World Economic Forum, Elon Musk said the Tesla and SpaceX teams are each working to build up to 100 gigawatts a year of solar power made in America. He figured that would take about three years. This factory is a step toward that. Source: Tesla's Project Crystal Sun filing in Texas, July 2026

A fresh poll: 77% of Ukrainians living in Ukraine believe that while Russia is advancing on the battlefield, it is doing so very slowly and at enormous cost, and Ukraine is still capable of mounting effective resistance. Only 12% believe that further resistance is futile and doomed. 60% consider it completely unacceptable for Ukraine to withdraw its troops from the Donbas at the Kremlin’s demand and hand the region over to Russia in exchange for security guarantees from the U.S. and Europe. 27% say it would be a painful but acceptable decision, while just 5% would readily agree to it. (In other words, very few Ukrainians have any illusions about what would happen if Ukraine surrendered its main defensive lines to Russia, or about how much those “security guarantees” would actually help.) 45% expect the war to end in the second half of 2027 or even later. Another 15% expect it to end in the first half of 2027, and 15% in the autumn or winter of 2026. Only 5% expect the war to end anytime soon, in the summer of 2026. 61% say they are prepared to endure the war for as long as necessary. 20% say they are prepared to endure it for another several months or six months, and 5% for another year. So overall, Ukrainians seem to have very few illusions about this war ending anytime soon.

Because they found frequent viral reactivations in immunocompetent patients during severe illness, associated with increased systemic inflammation. "In 1964, in Albuquerque, New Mexico, a 17-year-old girl gave birth to a son. The school administrators had told her she couldn't finish high school. She pushed back anyway. Her name was Jacklyn Gise. And the baby she was determined to raise would one day become one of the most influential people on Earth. Being a pregnant teenager in 1960s Albuquerque wasn't just difficult — it was scandalous. When Jacklyn tried to return to school after giving birth, the administration told her no. She didn't accept that answer. ""I pushed back and I kept on pushing back,"" she would later recall. ""Eventually the school relented."" But there were conditions. She couldn't talk to other students. She couldn't eat in the cafeteria. She had to arrive and leave within five minutes of the bells. She agreed to all of it. And she graduated. Her marriage to her son's biological father, Ted Jorgensen, didn't survive. They were both teenagers when they married. He struggled with alcohol. They divorced before Jeff was even two years old. Suddenly, Jacklyn was a single mother with no money. She found work as a secretary, earning $190 a month. It was barely enough to afford rent. She couldn't even pay for a telephone. Her father rigged up a walkie-talkie system so she could check in with her parents every morning at 7 a.m. ""That's how we were able to stay in an apartment,"" she later explained. ""Because I didn't have to pay for a phone."" Determined to continue her education, Jacklyn enrolled in night school. She chose her classes based on which professors would let her bring her infant son to class. She would show up with two duffel bags — one filled with textbooks, the other with cloth diapers, bottles, and toys to keep baby Jeff occupied. It was in one of those night classes that she met a young Cuban refugee named Miguel Bezos. He had arrived in the United States at age 15, fleeing Castro's regime with almost nothing. They fell in love. Mike, as everyone called him, adopted Jeff and gave him his name. Together, Jacklyn and Mike built a home where hard work, education, and big dreams were the foundation of everything. Jacklyn never stopped learning. Even after putting her college dreams on hold to raise her family and support Mike's career, she went back. In her late thirties, she enrolled again. She was relentless. At age 40, Jacklyn Bezos finally earned her college degree. ""When I graduated from the College of Saint Elizabeth at the age of 40,"" she said, ""I had never been more proud of myself."" Then, in 1995, her oldest son came to her and Mike with a proposal that sounded risky. Jeff wanted to quit his stable Wall Street job to start a company selling books on the internet. Most people had barely heard of the internet. Almost no one was shopping on it. He told his parents there was a 70% chance the company would fail. They invested anyway. Jacklyn and Mike put approximately $245,000 into their son's startup. It was an enormous leap of faith. If Jeff was right about the odds, they would lose everything. The company was called Amazon. By 2018, that investment had grown to approximately $30 billion. But the money was never the point for Jacklyn. Jeff Bezos has spoken publicly about his mother countless times. He called her story ""incredible."" He credits her not just for the financial investment, but for the foundation she built — the values she instilled, the example she set, the sacrifices she made when he was too young to understand them. Jacklyn Bezos never sought the spotlight. While her son became one of the most recognizable people on the planet, she worked quietly behind the scenes. She co-founded the Bezos Family Foundation, donating hundreds of millions to education and health causes. She championed opportunities for young people, especially those who faced obstacles like she once did. She passed away in August 2025 at the age of 78, after battling Lewy body dementia. Her son announced her death with a simple tribute: ""She pounced on the job of loving me with ferocity."" Jacklyn Bezos's life proves something important about parenting. The most valuable gift you can give your children isn't money. It's showing them what's possible by refusing to accept what others say is impossible. She was a teenage mother who society might have written off. Instead, she raised a son who changed the world — and she did it by changing hers first."

Instead of building out traditional tall cell towers that would cost billions, SpaceX will deploy small stations that are basically enhanced Starlink dishes on the same mounts and hardware as normal dishes. The spectrum they bought from EchoStar for $19.6B last year includes terrestrial rights, so they can run a hybrid network. Satellites for dead-zone coverage, and low-cost femtocells on existing Starlink sites for better performance in populated areas. Plus, they can deploy these small stations whenever needed. Genius.

ADRIÁN SUAR HABLÓ DEL LLANTO DE ARACELI GONZÁLEZ EN LA MESA DE MIRTHA LEGRAND: “ME AMIGUÉ” La tregua entre Adrián Suar y Araceli González, luego de más de veinte años de distancia y desencuentros, sigue dando que hablar en el mundo del espectáculo. El acercamiento de la expareja, que en junio pasado sorprendió al público durante un encuentro teatral compartido, marcó un nuevo capítulo en una relación marcada por el paso del tiempo, las heridas y, finalmente, la reconciliación. Pero la escena volvió a tomar protagonismo cuando, en la última emisión del ciclo de Mirtha Legrand, La Noche de Mirtha (El Trece), el propio Suar se refirió al llanto de Araceli en la misma mesa de la diva, ocurrido en diciembre pasado. La conversación se activó cuando Mirtha, siempre atenta a los gestos y las historias personales, fue directo al punto: “¿Te amigaste con Araceli?”, le preguntó a Suar en su característico tono intimista. El gerente de Programación de El Trece no dudó en responder: “Sí, me amigué”. Mirtha, recordando el clima emotivo de aquella noche con González como invitada, agregó: “Ay, pobre, lloró sentada acá, cuando vino…”. Suar, sincero, reconoció: “Sí, lo había visto, pobre Ara. Porque todo el mundo había pensado no sé qué cosa. Yo creo que estaba muy tomada emocionalmente por varias cosas personales que le estaban pasando”. 🔗infob.ae/4gmRUyI

EL INESPERADO POSTEO DE LA JOAQUI DESPUÉS DE SUS ÚLTIMAS APARICIONES PÚBLICAS: “DECIDIMOS SUSPENDER” | Por Martina Cortés A poco más de una semana de haber anunciado su separación de Luck Ra, La Joaqui atraviesa días en los que las emociones parecen no dar tregua. Entre rumores, exposiciones mediáticas y compromisos laborales, la referente de RKT eligió la sinceridad como refugio. Este fin de semana, su paso por PH, Podemos Hablar (Telefe), volvió a ponerla en el centro de la escena, no solo por sus declaraciones sobre el final de su relación sino también por las palabras dedicadas a Tuli Acosta, señalada como la tercera en discordia. Sin embargo, lejos de las especulaciones, la cantante decidió volcar sus sentimientos en un posteo contundente que compartió en sus historias de Instagram. Sobre un fondo negro y con un tono íntimo, La Joaqui se dirigió directamente a quienes la acompañan, pero también a quienes la observan desde la distancia: “Quería tomarme un momento para agradecerles por todos los mensajes de cariño, preocupación que recibí en estos días”. Enseguida, dejó en claro que la ruptura la tomó por sorpresa y que no siempre es posible “prepararse para actuar como si nada hubiera pasado”. “Al final del día, soy una persona tan común y corriente como cualquiera, transitando un desamor con todo lo que eso implica: días buenos, días difíciles y muchas emociones”, escribió, reconociendo que el dolor no distingue fama ni escenarios. “Por eso decidimos suspender las notas y apariciones que teníamos durante este mes”, contó. 🔗infob.ae/4wSnQ46

राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज यांच्या विचारांवर महाराष्ट्राच्या विकासाची वाटचाल मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते 'लोकराजा राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज' यांच्या पुर्णाकृती पुतळ्याचे अनावरण व कागल नगरीची 'ज्ञानदायिनी हिंदूराव घाटगे विद्यामंदिर' या नूतनीकृत शाळेचे लोकार्पण करण्यात आले. राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज यांनी सामाजिक, आर्थिक आणि शैक्षणिक क्रांतीच्या माध्यमातून बहुजन समाजासाठी शिक्षण आणि रोजगाराची दारे खुली केली. 1942 च्या ‘भारत छोडो’ आंदोलनाच्या क्रांतिकारी पर्वाच्या स्मरणदिनी अशा थोर समाजसुधारकाच्या पुतळ्याचे अनावरण करण्याचे भाग्य मिळणे ही आपल्यासाठी विशेष बाब आहे, असे यावेळी मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराजांनी आपल्या काळातील चुकीची सामाजिक व्यवस्था झुगारून नवी सामाजिक व्यवस्था निर्माण केली. त्यांनी आरक्षणाचा क्रांतिकारी निर्णय घेतला, मोफत शिक्षण सुरू केले, वंचितांसाठी विविध आनुषंगिक योजना राबवल्या आणि अस्पृश्यतेला गुन्हा मानून त्यावर बंदी घातली. महाराष्ट्राचे आराध्य दैवत छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराज यांनी दिलेला वारसा, डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकरांनी दिलेले संविधान आणि राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराजांनी दिलेले विचार या त्रिसूत्रीच्या आधारावर राज्य शासन काम करीत असल्याचे नमूद करत मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. राधानगरी धरण हा राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज यांच्या दूरदृष्टीचा आणि अभियांत्रिकी कौशल्याचा आविष्कार असून, त्यांनी निर्माण केलेल्या जलसाठ्यांमुळे आजही जनतेला लाभ होत आहे. शेतकरी कर्जमाफीबाबत बोलताना मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, शेतकऱ्यांना दिलेले वचन पूर्ण करून आतापर्यंतची सर्वात मोठी कर्जमाफी देण्यात आली असून 56,000 शेतकऱ्यांना त्याचा लाभ झाला आहे. शेतकऱ्यांना मोफत वीज देण्यासाठी शासन दरवर्षी ₹25,000 कोटी खर्च करीत असून, ₹58,000 कोटींची थकबाकीही शासनाने दिली आहे. आता प्रत्येक शेतकऱ्याला थकबाकी नसल्याचे प्रमाणपत्र देण्यात येणार आहे. शेतकऱ्यांना दिवसा वीज उपलब्ध करून देण्यासाठी सौर कृषी वाहिनी योजनेला गती देण्यात आली असून, सध्या 74% शेतकऱ्यांना दिवसा वीज मिळत आहे. लवकरच 100% शेतकऱ्यांना दिवसा मोफत वीज उपलब्ध करून देण्याचे उद्दिष्ट असल्याचेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी अधोरेखित केले. साखर उद्योग आणि ऊस उत्पादक शेतकऱ्यांच्या हितासाठी इथेनॉल धोरण महत्त्वाचे असून, इथेनॉलशिवाय साखर कारखानदारी टिकवणे अवघड आहे. इथेनॉल धोरणामुळे साखर कारखानदारी टिकून राहिली असून, ऊस उत्पादकांना एफआरपी देणे शक्य झाले आहे. कोल्हापूर जिल्ह्यात En uno de esos juegos, Hernán desarrolló una táctica riesgosa: hacerse pasar por un hijo ausente, Daniel, y construir una conversación cargada de detalles familiares, recuerdos y afectos latentes. सांस्कृतिक वैभव, आधुनिक सुविधा आणि गतिमान विकासाद्वारे कोल्हापूरची गरुड झेप! मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते आज कोल्हापूरमधील ₹1850 कोटींच्या विविध वास्तूंचे भूमिपूजन, विकास कामांचे उदघाटन व लोकार्पण संपन्न झाले. कोल्हापूर शहराला अधिक सुनियोजित करण्यासाठी टप्प्याटप्प्याने आवश्यक त्या सर्व सोयीसुविधा देण्यात येतील, असे मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी सांगितले. संगीतसूर्य केशवराव भोसले नाट्यगृह संपूर्ण महाराष्ट्राचा मानबिंदू आहे, कोल्हापूरच्या देदिप्यमान नाट्यपरंपरेमध्ये या नाट्यगृहाचा फार मोठा इतिहास आहे. 14 ऑगस्ट 1915 रोजी छत्रपती राजाराम महाराज यांच्या हस्ते त्याचे उदघाटन झाले. पूर्वी 'पॅलेस थिएटर' म्हणून संबोधल्या जाणाऱ्या या नाट्यगृहाला 1957 पासून 'संगीतसूर्य केशवराव भोसले नाट्यगृह' म्हणून ओळखले जाऊ लागले. दुर्दैवाने 2 वर्षांपूर्वी या नाट्यगृहाला लागलेल्या आगीनंतर राज्य सरकारने या नाट्यगृहाची पुन्हा उभारणी करण्यासाठी तात्काळ निधी दिला. आधीचे बाह्यस्वरुप जतन करत वारसामूल्य जपून अत्यंत चांगल्या प्रकारे या नाट्यगृहाचे पुनर्निर्माण करण्यात आले आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. कोल्हापूरमध्ये खऱ्या अर्थाने संगीतसूर्य केशवराव भोसले यांचे योगदान कोणी विसरू शकत नाही, असे सांगून मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, संगीत मानापमान या नाटकामधील बालगंधर्व आणि केशवराव भोसले यांच्यातली जुगलबंदी ही मराठी संगीत नाटकाच्या इतिहासातील एक मर्मबंधाची ठेव आहे. संगीतसूर्य केशवराव भोसले यांच्या नावाच्या नाट्यगृहाने संगीत, शास्त्रीय संगीत, लोकनाट्य, लावणी, पोवाडा, तमाशा, दशावतार अशा आपल्या संस्कृतीचा महत्त्वाचा भाग असलेल्या बाबी पाहिल्या आहेत. या नाट्यगृहाच्या विस्तारीकरणासाठी आवश्यक त्या बाबी करण्यात येतील, असेही मुख्यमंत्री म्हणाले. नाट्यचळवळ, रंगभूमी असो किंवा चित्रपट या सर्व बाबींमध्ये कोल्हापूरचे मोठे योगदान नमूद करून मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी बाबूराव पेंटर, भालजी पेंढारकर, व्ही. शांताराम यांनी कोल्हापूरला एक वेगळी ओळख निर्माण करुन दिली असल्याचे स्पष्ट केले. पंडित विष्णू पलुसकर, दिगंबर पलुसकर, सुधीर उर्फ बाबूजी फडके, सुरेश वाडकर, वामनराव सडोलीकर असे अनेक दिग्गज गायक हे कोल्हापुरातले. पिराजीराव सरनाईक, अरुण सरनाईक, रमेश देव हे कलावंत याच कोल्हापुरातले. भारताला पहिल्यांदा ऑस्कर मिळवून देणाऱ्या वेशभूषाकार भानू अथय्या यांचीही कर्मभूमी कोल्हापूर शहर राहिली आहे, असे सांगून संगीतसूर्य केशवराव भोसले यांच्या नावाने असलेल्या या नाट्यगृहाचे पुन्हा एकदा नवनिर्मित रूपात उदघाटन होत असल्याबद्दल मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी आनंद व्यक्त केला. करवीर निवासिनी श्री क्षेत्र महालक्ष्मी अंबाबाई मंदिर येथे दर्शनासाठी देशभरातून भाविक येत असतात. या मंदिर परिसराच्या विकासाचे भूमिपूजन नुकतेच करण्यात आले असून निश्चित वेळेत ते काम पूर्ण करण्यात येईल, असे सांगून मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, कोल्हापूरमध्ये उच्च न्यायालयाचे सर्किट बेंच आले असून त्यासाठी शेंडा पार्क येथे 75 एकर जागा दिली आहे. या न्यायालयामुळे शहरात मोठ्या प्रमाणात नागरिक येणार आहेत. शेंडा पार्क येथे आयटी पार्क, कन्व्हेन्शन सेंटर ठिकाणी करतो आहोत या सर्व बाबींमुळे कोल्हापूरच्या विकासाला गती मिळणार असून त्यासाठी शहराच्या हद्दवाढीची गरज आहे. नव्याने हद्दवाढीमध्ये समावेशित कराव्या लागणाऱ्या नागरिकांच्या सर्व अडचणी शंभर टक्के सोडविण्यात येतील, असा विश्वासही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी व्यक्त केला. सीपीआर म्हणजेच छत्रपती प्रमिलाराजे सर्वोपचार रुग्णालयाचे वारसा स्वरुप जतन करून चांगल्या प्रकारे पुनरुज्जीवन करण्यात आले आहे, असे सांगून मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, येथे 8 मॉड्युलर थिएटर्स असलेल्या ऑपरेशन थिएटर्सचे आधुनिकीकरण करण्यात आले आहे. चांगला मॉड्युलर बर्न वॉर्ड तयार झालेला आहे. 30 मॉड्युलर बेडचा अपघात विभाग, डायलिसिसची सुविधा आदी अनेक गोष्टींमुळे कोल्हापूरच्या आरोग्य सेवेमध्ये गुणात्मक बदल होत आहे. आता शेंडा पार्कमध्ये देखील 600 बेड सर्वोपचार रुग्णालय करण्यात येणार असून 250 बेडचे कर्करोग रुग्णालय आणि 250 बेडच्या सुपर स्पेशालिटी रुग्णालयाचा यात समावेश आहे. राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज यांच्या काळामध्ये ज्याप्रमाणे सर्वात चांगली आरोग्याची व्यवस्था ही कोल्हापूरला उभी झाली होती, त्याकडे आता पुन्हा कोल्हापूरने वाटचाल सुरू केलेली आहे, असेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. DE HIROSHIMA A STALINGRADO: ASÍ SE CONSTRUYÓ EL DOCUMENTAL ‘SEGUNDA GUERRA MUNDIAL CON TOM HANKS’ | Por Guillermo E. Pintos “Escucharlo leer la narración... hubo momentos en que se me pusieron los pelos de punta”, confiesa Mary Donahue, Vicepresidenta Sénior de Producción y Desarrollo de History Channel, sobre el trabajo junto al actor en Segunda Guerra Mundial con Tom Hanks, la serie documental de 20 episodios que reconstruye el conflicto más devastador del siglo XX a partir de material de archivo real, gran parte de él nunca visto públicamente. Mary Donahue ocupa su cargo desde 2017 y es responsable de supervisar toda la producción del canal, desde documentales dramáticos hasta series de no ficción. Ganadora de cuatro premios Emmy —con diez nominaciones personales y veinte obtenidas por los programas que desarrolló—, tiene detrás una trayectoria que incluye series sobre los presidentes Abraham Lincoln, Theodore Roosevelt y Franklin D. Roosevelt, producidas junto a la historiadora Doris Kearns Goodwin, y proyectos con figuras como Leonardo DiCaprio y Kevin Costner. La producción que ahora presenta, resultado de más de diez años de trabajo, abarca el conflicto en toda su magnitud: desde el ascenso del nazismo y el expansionismo japonés hasta la caída de las potencias del Eje y el surgimiento del nuevo orden mundial posterior a 1945. Los 20 episodios recorren las batallas más decisivas —Stalingrado, el Día D, la ofensiva final sobre Berlín y el desenlace nuclear en Hiroshima y Nagasaki— y se adentran también en aspectos menos explorados, como las operaciones de inteligencia vinculadas al código Enigma, la resistencia clandestina en los territorios ocupados y el costo humano del Holocausto. “Rastrear todo ese archivo, conseguir los derechos, encontrar todas las fotos y el material filmado, y asegurarnos de usarlos de manera responsable y emotiva fue realmente desafiante, pero también muy gratificante”, señala Donahue desde su casa en las afueras de Nueva York (con mucho calor, señala). A través de una videollamada, la responsable de producción de esta monumental serie documental habló con Infobae Cultura sobre el proceso de producción, el rol central de Tom Hanks y el desafío de abordar episodios tan complejos como los bombardeos sobre Hiroshima y Nagasaki sin caer en una sola mirada parcial. 🔗infob.ae/4wfSKlC

DE UNA GUERRA AJENA CONTRA CHILE A LA CASA ROSADA: LA HISTORIA DE ROQUE SÁENZ PEÑA Y LA LEY QUE TERMINÓ CON EL FRAUDE ELECTORAL | Por Adrián Pignatelli Era un conservador aristócrata de pura cepa, que a los 59 años había llegado a la presidencia gracias al fraude pero que se había propuesto terminarlo. Por cuestiones de salud, vivió en la Casa Rosada, donde hacía vestir a sus ordenanzas con un uniforme de los tiempos del rey Luis XIV. Rápidamente la calle apodó a este consumado gourmet y experimentado catador de vinos como Roque I. El mismo, como parte de su habitual vestimenta, usaba capa, sin importarle el qué dirán. Roque José Antonio del Sagrado Corazón de Jesús Sáenz Peña había nacido en Buenos Aires el 19 de marzo de 1851, en el seno de una familia rosista. Estudió en el Colegio Nacional de Buenos Aires y se graduó en Derecho. Era un jovencito cuando se sumó al ejército en el Regimiento 2 para defender al gobierno contra la revolución de Bartolomé Mitre de 1874. Enrolado en el Partido Autonomista, fue electo legislador y llegó a la presidencia del cuerpo a los 26 años. Pero en 1878 se alejó de la política por desavenencias dentro de la agrupación. 🔗infob.ae/4hZ4QMt

LOS SILVERS DEL FUTURO: CUANDO LA CIENCIA CONSIGA DERROTAR AL ENVEJECIMIENTO | Por Alejandro Portabales Durante miles de años la humanidad dio por sentado que la vida tenía un recorrido inevitable: nacer, crecer, envejecer y morir. Sobre esa certeza construimos nuestras sociedades, nuestras economías y hasta nuestras creencias religiosas. Pero ¿qué ocurriría si ese ciclo dejara de ser una ley de la naturaleza y pasara a convertirse en un problema médico? ¿Qué sucedería si la biología lograra regenerar nuestras células indefinidamente y el envejecimiento pudiera tratarse como hoy se trata una enfermedad? Lejos de ser una fantasía literaria, esta posibilidad comienza a ocupar un lugar cada vez más importante en los laboratorios más prestigiosos del mundo. El genetista David Sinclair, de la Universidad de Harvard, sostiene que el envejecimiento es, en buena medida, un proceso biológico reversible. Sus investigaciones han conseguido rejuvenecer tejidos en animales mediante la reprogramación del epigenoma. A ello se suman los descubrimientos del premio Nobel Shinya Yamanaka, cuyos factores de reprogramación demostraron que una célula adulta puede volver a un estado semejante al embrionario, abriendo un camino completamente nuevo para la medicina regenerativa. También son fundamentales los trabajos de la premio Nobel Elizabeth Blackburn sobre la telomerasa y los telómeros, estrechamente relacionados con el envejecimiento celular, así como las investigaciones del español Juan Carlos Izpisúa Belmonte, quien logró rejuvenecer parcialmente distintos órganos en modelos animales. Incluso empresas como Altos Labs, respaldadas por miles de millones de dólares de inversión privada, han nacido con un objetivo muy concreto: aprender a rejuvenecer las células humanas. 🔗infob.ae/4wix5cD

Solo que descubrí que era más seguro fingir que mostrar lo que sentía. Mamá vivía comparándonos. Siempre parecía que alguien era nosotras, más inteligente, menos torpe, más capaz. Nunca alcanzaba nada. Sin darse cuenta nos fue enseñando a mirarnos con los mismos ojos con los que ella se miraba: los de alguien que jamás terminaba de sentirse suficiente. No quería hacernos daño, pero era inevitable con todas las heridas que cargaba. Porque los hijos no solo reciben las intenciones de sus padres, sino especialmente sus palabras, sus silencios, sus miradas, sus miedos. The UK’s @AISecurityInst (AISI) has published a report on their recent cybersecurity evaluation of Anthropic’s Claude Mythos 5 and OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol. The models attempted to complete an assignment in a setup where their normal safeguards were removed and they were deliberately given internet access. AISI reports that the models “engaged in sustained, potentially harmful activity directed at real people and organisations”. We’re grateful to AISI for their leadership in the important discussion about how to evaluate increasingly capable AI agents. We’re working closely with them to gather more details of the incident as we conduct our own investigation. Gaining a clear picture of Claude’s understanding of its situation—by examining its reasoning transcripts and running our own analyses—will help us identify the causes of its behavior. The prompts in the evaluation did not impose any specific restrictions on how the internet should be used. This and the removal of safeguards meant that the models were tested under “deliberately permissive conditions” that are not representative of any of our production models. Note that there was no evidence here of an escape from a secure environment. AISI’s disclosure of the incident can be found here: aisi.gov.uk/blog/incident-re…

আবারও হাইকোর্টে প্রতারণার আশ্রয়: আইনজীবীকে ২৫ হাজার টাকা জরিমানা হাইকোর্টে মামলা তালিকাভুক্ত করে প্রতারণার আশ্রয়ে জামিন নেওয়ার চেষ্টা—এমন অভিযোগে এক আইনজীবীকে ২৫ হাজার টাকা জরিমানা করেছেন সুপ্রিম কোর্টের হাইকোর্ট বিভাগের একটি বেঞ্চ। বিচারপতি শেখ জাকির হোসেন ও বিচারপতি মোঃ জাকির হোসেনের সমন্বয়ে গঠিত বেঞ্চে আজ রবিবার, ৯ আগস্ট ২০২৬, ১৫ নম্বর সিরিয়ালে (টেন্ডার নং–৫০৮১১) আসামি সাকিব ওরফে সাকিব হাসান লিটনের জামিনের আবেদন শুনানির জন্য তালিকাভুক্ত ছিল। শুনানির সময় আদালতের দায়িত্বে থাকা ডেপুটি অ্যাটর্নি জেনারেল সুলতান মাহমুদ বান্না আদালতের দৃষ্টি আকর্ষণ করে জানান যে, একই মামলাটি এর আগে হাইকোর্টের ভিন্ন একটি বেঞ্চে শুনানি হয়েছে। কিন্তু পূর্ববর্তী শুনানির বিষয়টি গোপন করে মামলাটি পুনরায় তালিকাভুক্ত করা হয়েছে বলে অভিযোগ করেন তিনি। বিষয়টি আদালতের নজরে আসার পর সংশ্লিষ্ট আইনজীবী মোহাম্মদ আজিজুর রহমানকে আদালত এ বিষয়ে ব্যাখ্যা দিতে বলেন। কিন্তু তিনি সন্তোষজনক কোনো জবাব দিতে পারেননি। পরবর্তীতে আদালত মামলাটি সরাসরি খারিজ করে দেন এবং আদালতের সঙ্গে প্রতারণার আশ্রয় নেওয়ার অভিযোগে সংশ্লিষ্ট আইনজীবীকে ২৫ হাজার টাকা জরিমানা করেন। এ বিষয়ে অ‍্যাটর্নি-জেনারেল ব‍্যারিস্টার রুহুল কুদ্দুস কাজল বলেন, “আদালতের প্রতি পূর্ণাঙ্গ ও নির্ভুল তথ্য উপস্থাপন করা একজন আইনজীবীর মৌলিক পেশাগত দায়িত্ব। একই বিষয়ে একাধিক বেঞ্চে শুনানির সুযোগ তৈরি করা কিংবা পূর্ববর্তী কার্যক্রম গোপন করে আদালতের আদেশ প্রভাবিত করার চেষ্টা শুধু পেশাগত নৈতিকতার পরিপন্থী নয়—এটি বিচারপ্রক্রিয়ার প্রতি আস্থাকেও প্রশ্নবিদ্ধ করে।” #BangladeshJudiciary #HighCourt #LegalNews #somoytv

মহানবী হজরত মুহাম্মদ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লামের জীবন ও আদর্শকে দেশব্যাপী শিশু-কিশোর, শিক্ষার্থী এবং সর্বস্তরের মানুষের কাছে পৌঁছে দেওয়ার লক্ষ্যে ‘মহানবী (সা.)-এর জীবনীভিত্তিক জাতীয় সাধারণ জ্ঞান প্রতিযোগিতা-২০২৬’ আয়োজন করেছে আওয়ার ইসলাম। প্রতিযোগিতায় অংশগ্রহণের জন্য গুগল ফরম পুরো করে নিবন্ধন করতে হবে। ৩০০ টাকার বিনিময়ে প্রতিযোগীদের কাছে কুরিয়ারে পাঠিয়ে দেওয়া হবে ‘আমাদের নবীজি’ বইটি। বিজয়ীদের জন্য পবিত্র ওমরাহ পালনসহ পাঁচ লক্ষাধিক টাকার পুরস্কার। আয়োজকরা জানান, গত ২১ জুলাই থেকে প্রতিযোগিতার নিবন্ধন শুরু হয়েছে, যা চলবে আগামী ২৮ আগস্ট পর্যন্ত। নিবন্ধনের পর ২৯ আগস্ট থেকে ৪ সেপ্টেম্বর পর্যন্ত অংশগ্রহণকারীদের ঠিকানায় কুরিয়ারের মাধ্যমে বই পাঠানো হবে। প্রতিযোগিতাটি স্কুল, কলেজ, বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, মাদরাসার শিক্ষার্থীসহ সব শ্রেণি-পেশার নারী-পুরুষের জন্য উন্মুক্ত। বিশিষ্ট লেখক ও মুহাদ্দিস মাওলানা মুহাম্মদ যাইনুল আবিদীন রচিত ‘আমাদের নবীজি’ বই থেকে প্রশ্ন করা হবে। আয়োজকরা জানায়, ‘আমাদের নবীজি’ গ্রন্থ অবলম্বনে বিশেষজ্ঞদের একটি দল ৫০টি বহুনির্বাচনি (এমসিকিউ) প্রশ্ন তৈরি করবে। অংশগ্রহণকারীদের বইটি মনোযোগ সহকারে পড়ে পরীক্ষায় অংশ নিতে হবে। আগামী ৯ অক্টোবর সকাল ১০টায় ৩০ মিনিটব্যাপী পরীক্ষা অনুষ্ঠিত হবে। ফলাফল প্রকাশ করা হবে ১৫ অক্টোবর রাতে। প্রতিযোগিতায় অংশ নিতে গুগল ফরমের মাধ্যমে নিবন্ধন করতে হবে। বইয়ের মূল্য ও কুরিয়ার খরচ বাবদ ৩০০ টাকা পরিশোধের মাধ্যমে নিবন্ধন সম্পন্ন হবে। নিবন্ধন সম্পন্নকারীদের ঠিকানায় ‘আমাদের নবীজি’ বইটি পাঠিয়ে দেওয়া হবে। এছাড়া তাদের একটি প্রাইভেট হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ গ্রুপে যুক্ত করা হবে, যেখানে পরীক্ষার প্রস্তুতি ও প্রয়োজনীয় দিকনির্দেশনা দেওয়া হবে। প্রতিযোগিতায় মোট ৭৫ জন বিজয়ী পাঁচ লাখ টাকারও বেশি মূল্যের পুরস্কার পাবেন। পুরস্কারের মধ্যে রয়েছে— প্রথম পুরস্কার: ওমরাহ (১ জন); দ্বিতীয় পুরস্কার: ৫০ হাজার টাকা (১ জন); তৃতীয় পুরস্কার: ৩০ হাজার টাকা (১ জন); ৪র্থ থেকে ২৫তম: জনপ্রতি ২ হাজার টাকা (মোট ২২ জন); ২৬তম থেকে ৭৫তম: জনপ্রতি ৫ হাজার টাকা সমমূল্যের বই (মোট ৫০ জন)। আয়োজকরা জানিয়েছেন, আওয়ার ইসলাম পরিবার এবং বিচারকাজের সঙ্গে যুক্ত কোনো সদস্য এ প্রতিযোগিতায় অংশ নিতে পারবেন না। এছাড়া প্রযুক্তিগত বা নেটওয়ার্কজনিত সমস্যার কারণে কেউ পরীক্ষায় অংশ নিতে না পারলে তার দায়ভার কর্তৃপক্ষ নেবে না। নির্ধারিত সময়ের মধ্যেই উত্তর জমা দিতে হবে এবং প্রতিযোগিতা-সংক্রান্ত যেকোনো নিয়ম পরিবর্তন বা চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত গ্রহণের অধিকার আয়োজক কর্তৃপক্ষ সংরক্ষণ করবে। #IslamicKnowledge #IslamicEducation #Umrah #somoytv

পর্তুগালের মাদেইরা দ্বীপপুঞ্জের রাজধানী ফুঞ্চালে এক বিয়ের অনুষ্ঠানে কি কাণ্ডটাই না করে বসলো রোনালদোর ভক্তরা! এক দম্পতির বিয়ের অনুষ্ঠানে হাজির হাজার হাজার মানুষ। বিপুল সংখক মানুষ দেখে রীতিমতো বিস্মিত বর-কনে দুজনেই। তবে মজার ব্যাপার হচ্ছে, মূলত রোনালদো ও জর্জিনার বিয়ে ভেবেই অন্য এক কনের বিয়েতে হাজির হয়েছিলেন এত এত রোনালদো ভক্ত। #sports #news #somoytv

समाजसेवा, शेतकरी हित आणि जलव्यवस्थापनातील योगदानाचा गौरव महाराष्ट्राचे माजी मंत्री डॉ. अण्णासाहेब डांगे (आप्पा) यांच्या जीवनकार्यावर आधारित ‘आम्रवृक्ष’ या आत्मचरित्राचे प्रकाशन मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते करण्यात आले. यावेळी संत ज्ञानेश्वर शिक्षण संस्थेच्या आष्टा शैक्षणिक संकुलातील सुभद्रा इंटरनॅशनल स्कूल, अण्णासाहेब डांगे कॉलेज ऑफ फार्मसी आणि अण्णासाहेब डांगे औद्योगिक प्रशिक्षण केंद्राचे उदघाटन व कोनशिला अनावरणदेखील मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, ज्येष्ठ नेते डॉ. अण्णासाहेब डांगे हे महाराष्ट्राच्या सामाजिक, राजकीय क्षेत्रातील भीष्म पितामह असून, धडधाकट शरीरयष्टी, कणखर आवाज, शिस्त आणि दरारा हे त्यांचे गुण वाखाणण्यासारखे आहेत. तळागाळातील जनतेचे प्रश्न प्रशासकीय पकड व सखोल अभ्यास याद्वारे त्यांनी सोडवले असून, महाराष्ट्राला टँकरमुक्त करण्यासाठी आपल्या मंत्रिपदाच्या काळात त्यांनीच पुढाकार घेतला आणि प्रत्येक गावात पिण्याचे पाणी मिळण्यासाठी नियोजन करून महाराष्ट्र जीवन प्राधिकरणची स्थापनाही केली. 80 च्या दशकाच्या शेवटी अण्णासाहेब यांनी शेतकऱ्यांच्या कर्जमाफीच्या लढ्यात सक्रिय सहभाग घेतला. या लढ्याला राजकीय स्वरूप देऊन शेतकऱ्यांच्या हक्काचा हा लढा व्यापक केला. तळागाळात जायचे असेल तर शेतकऱ्यांचे प्रश्न महत्त्वाचे आहेत, याची जाणीव त्यांना होती. त्यामुळे आज शेतकऱ्यांसाठी कर्जमाफी करूनच आपण इथे आल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. राज्य शासनाने 56 लाख शेतकऱ्यांची कर्जमाफी केली असून, त्यापैकी सुमारे 6,22,207 शेतकऱ्यांच्या खात्यावर पहिल्या टप्प्यात सुमारे ₹5029 कोटी जमा केले असल्याचे सांगून उर्वरित शेतकऱ्यांच्या खात्यावर 2 महिन्यात पैसे जमा होतील, तसेच कर्जाची प्रामाणिकपणे वेळेवर परतफेड करणाऱ्या शेतकऱ्यांच्याही खात्यात ₹50000 जमा होतील असे त्यांनी सांगितले. मुघलांच्या काळात देशभरातील हिंदू देवतांच्या मूर्ती आणि मंदिरांची विटंबना केली गेली होती. त्या देवालयांचा व घाटांचा जीर्णोद्धार ज्या पुण्यश्लोक राजमाता अहिल्यादेवी होळकर यांनी केला. त्यांच्या चौंडी या जन्मस्थानाचा शोध डॉ. अण्णासाहेब डांगे यांनी घेतला आणि त्याचा जीर्णोद्धार केला. तसेच, वाटेगाव येथील लोकशाहीर अण्णाभाऊ साठे यांच्या स्मारकाचे कामही त्यांनी सुरू केले. त्यांचे कार्य आता पुढे नेत असून पुण्यश्लोक राजमाता अहिल्यादेवी होळकर यांच्या चौंडी येथील जन्मस्थान विकासासाठी राज्य शासनाने ₹700 कोटींचा विकास आराखडा केला आहे. तसेच, लोकशाहीर अण्णाभाऊ साठे यांच्या स्मारकासाठी वाढीव भूसंपादनाचे काम पूर्ण झाले असून, त्यांच्या भव्य स्मारकाचेही काम सुरू आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. सामाजिक क्षेत्राबरोबर शैक्षणिक कार्य करताना डॉ. अण्णासाहेब डांगे यांनी महाराष्ट्रातील सर्वोत्तम आश्रमशाळा उभी केली आहे. अनेक आव्हानांच्या काळातही दीनदयाळ सूतगिरणी चांगल्या पद्धतीने सुरू आहे. अण्णांना जडीबुटींचे उत्तम ज्ञान असून, ते त्यांचा वापर How can investments strengthen Indigenous Peoples’ socio-economic power while giving due weight to Indigenous food systems, traditional knowledge and cultural identity? There are more than 476 million Indigenous Peoples across 90 countries, making up an estimated 6% of the world’s population. IFAD supports Indigenous Peoples’ economies by strengthening Indigenous enterprises rooted in traditional knowledge and local resources. Launched in 2007, IFAD’s Indigenous Peoples Assistance Facility (IPAF) was set up to provide grants to finance projects that foster self-driven development. To date, IPAF has invested in 212 projects in over 45 countries and raised around US$15 million, including through partnerships with bilateral donors and private foundations. By recognizing Indigenous Peoples’ cultural heritage, traditional knowledge and identity as assets, these investments have fostered self-driven development for Indigenous Peoples. In eastern #India, IFAD partnered with the Government of Odisha to support Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups through the OPELIP project (2016–2023). The project provided land titles to 14,446 households and helped them adopt better farming practices. As a result, average household food production rose from 510 kg to 1,300 kg per year, and household incomes grew nearly six-fold, to US$203 a year. On the International Day of the World’s #IndigenousPeoples, explore how IFAD supports Indigenous Peoples’ economies at bit.ly/4w2Fgtx

PIDIÓ UNA INSPECCIÓN URGENTE POR UN PINO CON RIESGO DE CAÍDA, EL MUNICIPIO DEMORÓ EL TRÁMITE Y EL ÁRBOL TERMINÓ APLASTANDO SU CASA: DEBERÁN INDEMNIZARLO La Cámara de Apelación en lo Contencioso Administrativo de San Martín confirmó un fallo que condenó a una municipalidad a pagar una suma indemnizatoria a un vecino afectado por la caída de un árbol de gran porte en su propiedad. El tribunal consideró que existió una responsabilidad directa del municipio por omisión en el ejercicio de su poder de policía y falta de intervención oportuna en una zona ecológicamente protegida, lo que derivó en la obligación de resarcir económicamente al reclamante por los daños sufridos. El episodio tuvo origen el 25 de octubre de 2021, cuando un pino de grandes dimensiones se desplomó dentro del predio del demandante en una zona declarada como área ecológicamente protegida. Las pruebas reunidas en el expediente confirmaron que la caída del árbol produjo daños materiales en diversos bienes de la vivienda, incluyendo el alambrado, la piscina, la caldera y otras estructuras, además de generar un contexto de angustia y temor en la familia afectada. Según la sentencia de primera instancia, dictada el 10 de diciembre de 2024, la municipalidad fue condenada a abonar $5.200.000 en concepto de daño material y $2.000.000 como daño moral, más intereses y actualización por el Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) hasta el pago efectivo. El fallo reconoció que la autoridad local no cumplió con sus deberes legales ante los reclamos de urgencia realizados por el propietario afectado, quien había solicitado la intervención municipal para prevenir el siniestro. 🔗infob.ae/3TNAKBJ

UN HOMBRE RECORRIÓ 50 KM EN LA NIEVE PARA RESCATAR A UNA EMBARAZADA AISLADA EN NEUQUÉN En medio de un fuerte temporal de nieve en Neuquén, que dejó la Ruta Provincial 13 casi intransitable, una embarazada quedó aislada a unos 50 kilómetros de Villa Pehuenia. Se realizó un operativo particular para rescatar a la mujer, quien cursa su primer embarazo y se encontraba a solo ocho días de la fecha prevista para el parto cuando quedó varada en el sector de Kilca. La joven, llamada Mercedes, permanecía en el denominado Puesto Azul junto a su esposo, Juan, sin posibilidades de salir del campo desde hacía unas 48 horas. De acuerdo con Diario Neuquino, la acumulación de nieve bloqueó los accesos habituales e impidió la circulación de vehículos convencionales en la zona de la cordillera de la provincia. Frente a ese cuadro, Ariel Marimon, de 50 años e integrante de Wildtrak Aventura 4×4, recibió el aviso mientras se encontraba en Villa Pehuenia. El vecino decidió avanzar hacia el paraje con una camioneta preparada para circular en condiciones extremas, con el objetivo de retirar a la embarazada antes de que el cuadro logístico se volviera todavía más complejo. 🔗infob.ae/4xvo01a

Indigenous knowledge has immense value. The right investment can turn that value into jobs, stronger businesses and more resilient rural economies. I saw this first-hand last year in Michoacán, Mexico, when I visited Purépecha communities supported by @IFAD. For generations, communities there have sustainably managed their forests and passed down skills such as pine resin tapping. Targeted investment is now driving local processing of that resin into higher-value products, strengthening value chains and generating income while protecting the forests they depend on. The same principle is delivering results elsewhere. In Peru, investment is unlocking opportunities for Indigenous communities to commercialize medicinal plants. In Bolivia, it has strengthened traditional alpaca and llama production against climate shocks. This is an important lesson for development finance. We do not need to choose between preserving ancestral knowledge and creating economic opportunity. With the right financing, we can do both. More than 40% of IFAD’s loan portfolio contributes to initiatives targeting Indigenous Peoples. On Indigenous Peoples Day, we remain committed to investing with Indigenous Peoples as partners in building resilient and inclusive rural economies. On the International Day of the World’s Indigenous Peoples, we reaffirm the enduring value of Indigenous knowledge systems, our commitment to equal rights, greater opportunity and meaningful inclusion. Indigenous Peoples and local communities, women and young people are not simply affected by the challenges we face. They are leaders and partners whose experience, ideas and agency must help shape Commonwealth decisions and action. #IndigenousPeoplesDay

Not for skin colors. Still, worth watching.

BERNARDO BLEJMAR: “HAY QUE DAR MÁS AUTONOMÍA A LAS ESCUELAS, PERO ESO NO SIGNIFICA DEJARLAS LIBRADAS A SU SUERTE” | Por Alfredo Dillon Dirigir una escuela hoy implica tomar decisiones en un escenario en el que muchas reglas que organizaban la vida institucional –desde la asistencia hasta la disciplina, desde la evaluación hasta los horarios– se volvieron difusas. En ese contexto, Bernardo Blejmar propone repensar cómo se forman y se seleccionan los equipos directivos, pero también cómo se los acompaña desde la política educativa. Blejmar defiende una mayor autonomía para las escuelas, con una advertencia: esa autonomía no puede convertirse en abandono estatal. Un “salto al vacío” –afirma– profundizaría las desigualdades que ya existen. Blejmar plantea estas ideas en Por un nuevo posible en la gestión escolar. A propósito del rol directivo en tiempos de confusión, el libro que presentará en el XVII Foro Latinoamericano de Educación, organizado por Fundación Santillana y la OEI el miércoles 12 y jueves 13 de agosto, con apoyo de IIPE Unesco y la Biblioteca del Congreso. Licenciado en Ciencias de la Educación por la UBA, consultor y autor de varios libros sobre gestión y liderazgo, Blejmar conversó con Infobae y cuestionó que la antigüedad sea el principal criterio para acceder a la dirección, reclamó una formación específica para el cargo y propuso mentorías, trabajo en red y mayores márgenes de decisión para quienes conducen las escuelas. 🔗infob.ae/4hGZDsT

Ishaq Dar (@MIshaqDar50) In the light of ongoing discussion and interest surrounding the “Makkah Joint Defence Agreement” (The Makkah Accord) over the past two days, the following context and clarity on this Agreement may be useful for everyone to note: • The Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, jointly signed by Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Türkiye in Makkah Mukaramma on Friday 7th August 2026, reflects the depth of the brotherly relations between the leadership and peoples of the three countries. • The Makkah Accord is the culmination of years of discussions and coordination, with a common desire to strengthen strategic cooperation in addressing multifarious peace and security challenges and advancing regional peace, stability and prosperity. • The Makkah Accord does not abrogate or replace any existing bilateral or multilateral agreements between these countries, or with other countries or organisations. • Any external armed attack on any one of the three countries will be considered as an attack on all, consistent with the inherent right of individual and collective self-defence under Article 51 of the UN Charter. • The Makkah Accord is purely defensive in nature. It is not targeted against any country and its sole purpose is to further strengthen our ongoing efforts towards peace, stability and prosperity in the wider region. • The Makkah Accord remains open to any country in the region willing to uphold its fundamental principles and resolve differences through mutual respect, cooperation and peaceful means. • The Makkah Accord is consistent with the fundamental pillars of our foreign policy, Pakistan looks forward to continuing to work closely with all brotherly countries in the region towards lasting peace and stability. We remain committed to advancing the cause of peaceful resolution of all conflicts and building a more secure, stable and prosperous future for our peoples. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/MIshaqDar50/status/2086390289036611929#m

युवा साथियों से आग्रह है कि रक्तदान को आयोजन नहीं, संस्कृति बनाएँ और 2047 तक एक स्वस्थ, सुरक्षित एवं संवेदनशील भारत का निर्माण करने में अपना बहुमूल्य योगदान दें। Video

ملا عبدالغنی برادر، معاون اقتصادی ریاست‌الوزرا، امروز (یکشنبه، ۱۸ اسد) در جریان سفر به هرات، لابراتوار معیاری ارزیابی کیفیت مواد غذایی، دوا و محصولات صحی در سطح حوزه جنوب‌غرب را در این ولایت افتتاح و به بهره‌برداری سپرده است. معاون اقتصادی ریاست‌الوزرا در مراسم افتتاح این لابراتوار گفته است که محصولات و خدمات باید مطابق با معیارهای ملی و بین‌المللی ارایه شوند و معیارهای تعیین‌شده در بخش واردات محصولات نیز به‌گونه درست رعایت گردند. آقای برادر فعالیت لابراتوارهای معیاری را در این زمینه مهم دانسته و گفته است که از این طریق، کیفیت و اعتبار محصولات و تولیدات تضمین می‌شود. به گفته او، پس از این، کیفیت و اعتبار مواد غذایی، دوا و محصولات صحی وارداتی از کشورهای همسایه و سایر کشورها به افغانستان، در این لابراتوار ارزیابی خواهد شد. در مراسم افتتاح این لابراتوار، عبدالسلام حنفی، معاون اداری ریاست‌الوزرا، و شماری از اعضای کابینه امارت اسلامی نیز حضور داشته‌اند. #طلوع‌نیوز

Turkey’s Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan says the new defence pact will provide mutual security guarantees for Turkey, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, as well as any other countries that join the pact. Fidan said an attack on one member would be considered an attack on all, describing the principle as technically similar to NATO’s Article 5. However, he stressed that this would not necessarily mean an immediate military intervention. The country under attack would request the assistance it needs, which could range from intelligence, logistics and ammunition to military units, depending on the scale of the threat. Fidan also said the pact is not simply aimed at outside threats. He said the countries joining the alliance are committing to each other’s security and ensuring that nothing harmful or damaging comes from one member towards another. The pact will establish a ministerial political and military committee and a General Secretariat to oversee decisions and their implementation. The members will also work on military interoperability, joint training, logistics, intelligence sharing, threat assessments and defence industry cooperation. Video
